name: Grateful
overview: Scripture calls believers to a life marked by continual gratitude, as seen in Ephesians 5:20 and Colossians 4:2, where giving thanks in all circumstances is linked with prayer and worship. This gratefulness flows from a transformed mind (Romans 12:2) that discerns God's perfect will and expresses itself through acts of generosity and support for others, reflecting the blessing of giving over receiving highlighted in Acts 20:35. Obedience to God's commands without alteration (Deuteronomy 12:32) grounds this thankful lifestyle in faithfulness to His revealed Word.
